thread:
Alex: Heads up — planning kernel+quant rollout for Tue 2026-04-14 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need someone to claim canary slice and own smoke + rollback readiness. I'll drive the rollout but can't be on the late window AM. :wave:

Maria: I can cover the first hour (03:00-04:00 UTC). What slice numbers are we using? Also need confirmation on which quant profile (v1.06 or v1.07).

Chen: Is model-agg-2 included in this canary? last time that model needed a special kernel flag.

Alex: Good Q — canary = slice-7, slice-8. No model-agg-2 in those slices. Quant profile: v1.07 (adds 4-bit fp16 fallback). We validated locally against small workload.

Priya: I'll take canary owner. Plan: smoke tests at +5m, +20m, +40m. I'll post smoke checklist. :thumbsup:

Priya: Smoke checklist:
- smoke-perf: 95th latency under 220ms
- token correctness: run prompt-regressions/quickset
- error rate < 0.5%
- KV cache sanity (fetch a 512-step resume)

Sam: link to runbook? please paste the quick rollback commands here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-04-14 03:00-05:00 UTC (ID: maint-20260414-01)

Priya: Rollback plan (fast):
1) Pause traffic to canary slices
2) Repoint routing to previous model variant (stable-2026-04-12)
3) Trigger slot rollback: 
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --slice slice-7 --to stable-2026-04-12 --reason "smoke fail"
```
4) Revert quant profile

Chen: For perf smoke, run:
```
./tools/smoke_runner --backend=canary --qprofile=v1.07 --payload=quick.json --duration=2m
```
I'll run this against slice-8 at +5m.

Maria: quick note — infra unit test 103 fails on staging with kernel shim bump. Not blocking canary but watch for OOMs.

Priya: noted. I'll keep an eye on pod OOMs and memory churn. If OOMs > 2 in 10m we rollback.

Alex: Thanks. Priya + Maria own smoke. Chen runs perf. Sam will handle post-rollout announce and escalation channel. I'll be on standby until 04:30 UTC. :eyes:

Sam: I'll create a short post with links to logs + rollback commands in #eng-releases after we start.

ops-bot: Reminder: backup of KV cache snapshots scheduled at 02:45 UTC before rollout.

Priya: All set, claiming slices. ping me in thread when you start so I can stamp canary live. :rocket:

Maria: I'll post any infra test updates here. If we see regressions, tag @Alex @Priya.

Alex: Sweet. Starting preflight at 02:30 UTC. Thanks team.
